text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementGeoscienceDoes Earth’s Magnetic Field Affect Aging?The secret may lie in the mitochondriaJCBy Jake Currie3:00 PM CDT on September 23, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleFor as long as there’s been life on Earth it’s been shielded by our planet’s magnetic field. And yet, we still don’t know a lot about how this invisible protector has shaped our biology. A new study published in the journal Aging is aiming to correct this by making that field disappear. Subscribe to skip adsFeatured Video“We live our entire lives within the Earth’s magnetic field,” study author Lisa Chakrabarti of Nottingham University explained in a statement. “It passes through our bodies, our cells and every living organism on the planet, yet we know surprisingly little about whether and how this invisible force affects the way our cells work.”Read more: “How Our Perceptions of Aging Can Affect Our Social Lives”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
